parsed.name: 线段图形标注对象
parsed.description: 这不是独立物理仪器，而是科学成像软件中的线段/箭头图形标注对象，用于在实验图像或数据视图上定义起点、终点、长度、角度和方向，并支持拖拽、微调与区域交互，常用于显微图像或其他科研数据的标记与测量辅助。
parsed.description_en: This is not a standalone physical instrument but a line/arrow graphic annotation object used in scientific imaging software. It defines a start point, end point, length, angle, and direction on experimental images or data views, and supports dragging, nudging, and interactive region editing for marking and measurement assistance in microscopy or other research datasets.
